lines.name: Dana Whitfield
lines.content: Hi Peter, this is Dana over at United Material Handling. Do you have a couple of minutes to talk about the reach trucks you were asking about?

lines.name: Peter De Haan
lines.content: Yeah, now's fine. We've got three aisles we can't service properly with what we have.

lines.name: Dana Whitfield
lines.content: Got it. What's the rack height in those aisles, and how many hours a day would these be running?

lines.name: Peter De Haan
lines.content: About thirty foot. Two shifts, so call it sixteen hours. What are we looking at on price?

lines.name: Dana Whitfield
lines.content: For a thirty foot reach truck you're looking at around 42000 per unit, and I can guarantee we'll have them on site by the fifteenth.

lines.name: Peter De Haan
lines.content: That's higher than I hoped. Crown quoted us a little under forty.

lines.name: Dana Whitfield
lines.content: I hear you. I can do 8 percent off if you take all three, and I'll follow up soon with something in writing.

lines.name: Peter De Haan
lines.content: Alright. We're deciding by the end of the month, so send it over and I'll take it to Sandra in purchasing.
